title: Cycle 24: local-auth refresh-token rotation + family invalidation
summary: Closed the loopback-token replay window by implementing refresh-token rotation with family invalidation on BrowserOS and a matching refresh flow in TriOS. The access token stays 15 minutes, the refresh token rotates on every use, and reuse of an old refresh token revokes the whole family.
weak_spots: Single access token replayable until TTL expiry
No server-side audit of token usage
Tests did not cover TTL metadata or refresh path

variants.A: Server-side audit + rate limiting on auth failures
variants.C: Biometric Keychain binding + per-route capability tokens

lessons: Store token hashes, not raw tokens; validate with timingSafeEqual on hashes.
Refresh endpoint must distinguish family revocation (401) from missing auth (403) so the client can bootstrap.
Set JSONDecoder.dateDecodingStrategy = .iso8601 when the server returns ISO-8601 strings.
Audit logs must be token-free by design.
Single-flight deduplication wraps bootstrap and refresh under one task.
